item.title: Marquette father continues fight for safer social media as landmark trial nears verdict
item.description: As closing arguments wrap up in a landmark social media lawsuit in California, Marquette father John Demay says the case could reshape how tech companies are held accountable for harm to young users. Demay’s son Jordan died after a sextortion scheme on Instagram, a tragedy that has fueled his advocacy for stronger online protections.
